_comment: How a thinker.dll's own label (its MOD_VERSION) is read and named to the player. Shared by the DLL (src/uimod/src/thinkercheck_core.h, through tests/test_thinker_check.py) and by any Python reader of the same grammar. 'label' is the string; 'run' is {RUN}; 'run_vs' is {RUN} when compared with the version in 'vs'; 'same' is whether the label is a plain version equal to 'vs'.
